Question: A train, an hour after starting, meets with an accident which detains it a half hour, after which it proceeds at \(\dfrac34\) of its former rate and arrives \(3\dfrac12\) hours late. Had the accident happened \(90\) miles farther along the line, it would have arrived only \(3\) hours late. The length of the trip in miles was:
